subject: Coordinated short-window headroom & deferred settlement for launch
messages:
From: ops@heliumai.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Need short-window headroom for launch next week

Mina / Ben —

We have a sudden shift in traffic for an impending feature flag rollout next Wednesday. The engineering team expects a ~6-hour spike that will exceed our current quota by ~3–4x for that window. Can Redwood provide a short-window capacity buffer (ephemeral headroom) and push billing to a deferred/escrow path so we don't get hit by a large overrun invoice immediately?

Key asks:
- Temporary capacity increase for 6–8 hours on 2025-06-11 (PST)
- Option to defer invoice settlement for that burst for 30 days (we can pay post-launch)
- Any blunt-rate or surcharge guidance so we can plan cost in the launch runbook

Thanks —
Ops Team
Helium AI

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: aisha@heliumai.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need short-window headroom for launch next week

Aisha —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the rollout. We can absolutely support a focused 8-hour headroom window. Quick proposal to align with procurement and your finance team: 

1) Capacity lane: provision an ephemeral burst pool sized to cover ~4x your baseline QPS for an 8-hour window on 2025-06-11 09:00–17:00 PST.

2) Billing path: escrowed settlement — we create a provisional invoice and hold the amount in escrow for up to 30 days. Final true-up occurs after you confirm retrospective usage. This avoids surprise charge to your month-end card.

3) Rates and discounts: standard overrun surcharge is 1.5x our committed rate. For Helium (deal HL-2025-06-01) we can cap the surcharge at 1.25x for this one-off launch if you sign the attached escrow terms and accept a 10% non-refundable finders fee to cover capacity reserve costs.

4) SLA & rollback: if headroom isn't needed we won't provision; if we hit sustained elevation beyond the 8-hour window we'll notify and discuss options (auto-throttle or extended window at the negotiated surcharge).

I'll attach the escrow_terms_v1.pdf and a provisional invoice for your procurement team to review. Jordan, Ben — can you confirm legal OK on the 10% reserve and fast DocuSign?

Next steps (recommended):
- Helium legal signs escrow_terms_v1.pdf by EOD Monday (2025-06-09)
- We provision a reserved burst slot (non-binding until signed)
- Post-launch true-up and settlement within 30 days

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Account Lead — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: escrow_terms_v1.pdf (stub)
From: aisha@heliumai.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, ops@heliumai.com
Date: 2025-06-08T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need short-window headroom for launch next week

Mina —

Appreciate the quick proposal. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- Can you move the 10% reserve into a one-time fee applied to the provisional invoice rather than non-refundable? The finance team prefers to apply it against the final amount if usage materializes.
- We're comfortable with a 1.25x cap on the surcharge but would like the cap to only apply up to a $X spend threshold (we propose $25k) — beyond that can we revert to the standard 1.5x?
- Need confirmation that the escrow mechanism will not impact our existing committed capacity credits for June.

If we can get those three items confirmed, Helium legal will sign the escrow terms ASAP. Also adding: can we get a short note in the terms that lists a rollback window (15-minute notification for emergency throttle) so our on-call knows what to watch for?

Thanks —
Aisha Kaur
Head of Platform Ops
Helium AI
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: aisha@heliumai.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-08T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need short-window headroom for launch next week

Aisha —

Thanks — all reasonable asks. Agreed updates below, I'll get legal to amend the escrow draft and route for signature: 

- Reserve fee: convert to a credit-applied provisional line item (if usage occurs the 10% reduces the final true-up; if no usage, we apply a $500 administrative pass-through to cover provisioning work).
- Surcharge cap: 1.25x up to $25,000 of burst spend; beyond $25,000 revert to 1.5x. We'll surface alerts at $15k and $22.5k so you have early visibility.
- Committed credits: provisioning ephemeral headroom will not consume your committed baseline credits — this is billed as an overrun lane separate from the commit.
- Rollback/notification: we will include a 15-minute emergency throttle clause and a 5-minute pre-throttle alert via your webhook and email.

Ben (cc) confirmed we can expedite the DocuSign and lock the slot once we receive signed escrow_terms_v1.pdf. Ben — please confirm final approval for the $500 administrative fallback fee so Helium legal has clarity.

Aisha — expect an updated escrow_terms_v1_aml.pdf and a DocuSign link within the hour. We'll provision the slot in pending state once signed.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Senior Account Lead — Redwood Inference
